prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +3.1%), but can also severely backfire (-8.9%) or show no clear effect, with positive predictions often being too high.
Copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful; launch button predictions were too low (+6.7% measured vs +0.5% predicted), while general intro copy showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and interactive guides carry severe risk, hurting performance far worse than predicted (-10.1%, -19.3%), while others showed no clear effect.
Notifications, hints, waiting screens, and checklist layout changes showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -11.7% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +6.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: -5.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -10.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.0% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.5% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 67.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Account Protection Copy: Updates the headline and text on the adoption certificate screen to reassure users that their pet and progress are automatically saved to their account. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after sign in, and adoption step drops off to 60.9% conversion.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Card: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a centered layout with clear instructions on how to reveal, hide, and interact with the pet once on the desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and the finish step conversion is only 67.1%.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Photo Upload: Moves sign-in to take place immediately after photo upload, letting users customize their pet before creating or logging into an account. (why: Reordering flows delivered past wins (+12.0%) by aligning account creation with user investment in pet creation.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Instant Account Recovery Copy on Sign-In: Updates the sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that existing pets and progress will be instantly restored upon signing in. (why: 8 support emails noted pet reset or disappearance issues after signing back in.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines Assistance: Adds explicit photo upload hint text detailing lighting and focus tips for optimal custom pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom results.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Story-To-Path Direct Transition Redesign: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a stage layout that directly continues the story intro. (why: choose_path sees a 21.7% drop-off right at the start of onboarding (78.3% conversion).)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Generation Safety Info: Enables progress indicator and reassuring body text on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step (home target) has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing drop-offs if users think the app stalled.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Sign-In Provider Reassurance Banner: Switches sign-in screen to a split layout highlighting safe cloud saving alongside authentication choices. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in stalls, while 8 reported account sync issues after re-login.)
